page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred lines; an engraving (woodcut) in the centre; handwritten annotations at the right margin are not printed and are left out.

main_text.l: ACCESSERVNT operi Indices duo rerum & locorum
Ecce agnus ille Dei, qui tollit peccatum mundi, Ioan. 1.

page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre of the page (a tree and a seated figure with a landscape) is described, not transcribed. Handwritten ink notes at the right (library ownership and shelf marks) are not printed text and are omitted. The page number "1" at top right is handwritten and therefore not included as a printed page number; the printed page number is absent. Printed "s" forms in the title are rendered as plain s where present. The Roman numeral line "CLXXV." is printed with a bar over it.
